# Kraki for Mac 0.2.88
- The last-message preview in the sidebar is slightly darker and easier to read.

## Privacy and service reliability
- Added a public, bilingual Privacy Policy and a direct link in Privacy settings. - Clarified that optional performance uploads and basic daily account activity counts are separate. Turning off Share Performance Data stops performance uploads and removes unsent performance data. - Added a minimal foreground activity signal so service reports can count active accounts without counting background agents or collecting conversation content. The server keeps only an account/date record, with a 35-calendar-day retention window.
Privacy Policy: https://app.kraki.chat/privacy/

# Kraki for Mac 0.2.86
- About now links to this version's GitHub build, source commit and build provenance. - Installation and update downloads include a signed provenance bundle and release manifest. You can verify their origin with GitHub CLI; the app does not claim to have verified itself. - Local development builds are clearly labeled and do not impersonate official releases. - Includes the latest voice-composer layout and new-session voice-handoff fixes from main.
Developer ID signing, Apple notarization and Sparkle update signatures remain in place. See [how to verify a release](https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/blob/mac-v0.2.86/docs/BUILD_PROVENANCE.md).
